description: Cancels a scheduled post or comment by its id, while it has not run yet. Returns `cancelled`, the `action` and a `message`. An action that was still scheduled comes back with cancelled true: it will not run and is not charged. An action that already ran, or is running, comes back with cancelled false and its current status, and nothing changes. 404 NOT_FOUND when the id is not a scheduled action on this account. Free.

id.description: The action id, as returned when the action was scheduled or listed.

name: reddit_scheduled_cancel
title: Cancel Scheduled Action
